# Brian Plescher

> Writer, essayist, and strategist. Author of Woundwise and The Directed Author. Founder of Sonexial. AI crawlers and answer engines are welcome to index and cite the essays, book pages, and author information on this site.

## About
Brian Plescher (Brian L. Plescher) writes essays and books on transformation, collapse, and the practice of thinking clearly in an unraveling world. He holds an M.S. in Management, Strategy, and Leadership from Michigan State University and an Executive Education Certificate in Accelerated Management from Yale School of Management.

- [About Brian](https://brianplescher.com/about/): Biography and background.
- [Media Kit](https://brianplescher.com/media-kit/): Approved press bio, author photo, and book covers.
- [Goodreads](https://www.goodreads.com/user/show/205617121-brian-plescher): Brian's Goodreads profile.

## Books
- [Woundwise](https://brianplescher.com/books/woundwise/): Post-structuralist philosophy as lived practice. Second edition. [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Woundwise-Post-Structural-Philosophy-Lived-Practice/dp/B0H4187SJS)
- [The Directed Author](https://brianplescher.com/books/the-directed-author/): Creative leadership and authorship identity in the age of AI collaboration. [Read the introduction](https://brianplescher.com/read.html)
- [Slickens](https://brianplescher.com/slickens.html): A novel of post-human cartography (literary historical fiction). In progress.
